title: Report the members
prompt: Members `health` at 80 and `level` at 2 exist. Write `report`, which prints health and then level, and call it from `run`.
starter:
var health = 80
var level = 2

func run():
	pass
hints: Any function can read the members directly.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.

solution:
var health = 80
var level = 2

func run():
	report()

func report():
	print(health)
	print(level)
